'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Orlie Martin LS Infiltration''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Orlie Martin]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Infiltration / Unlikely Allies]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
